# AGENTS.md — GitHub Actions

Run jobs on Windows runners (`windows-*` labels) under native `pwsh`. The pull-request `windows` job is the deliberate exception: it runs Windows Node under Wine on hosted Linux and blocks `all checks passed`; `windows-native` runs on plain `windows-latest` and reports independently. All pull-request jobs in `ci.yml` run on plain GitHub-hosted runners (`ubuntu-latest` / `windows-latest`); this repository has no self-hosted or enterprise runner pool. `ci.yml` is pull-request-only; the `serial-windows` standby, the `serial-linux-selfhosted` standby, the `wine-apt-cache` seeder, and the two manual runner benchmarks live in `ci-master.yml`, which triggers only on `workflow_dispatch` — its standby jobs still gate on a push-to-master `if:` internally, so they stay dormant until this repository regains both a push trigger and the self-hosted pools those jobs assume. Because `ci-master.yml` does not listen to `pull_request`, its jobs never appear in PR check panels (a job a workflow defines for a given event is listed and shows `skipped` when its `if` is false); keeping them in a separate workflow is what stops PR check circles from showing gray segments.
